notes.title: MERRY FISHMAS!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/d10c8bd928be1064031baf06e5e43c2a3106b5b1.png
Hey, angling folks! Have yourself a great Christmas and join in on the Merry Fishmas adventures in Fishing Planet! 

Christmas starts on December 18th and will be available through January 10th.

This year, Christmas festivities are under threat! Santa’s sled was wrecked in a terrible snowstorm and crashed somewhere over Canada. Luckily, Santa is doing fine...but his reindeer went missing and all of the Christmas presents are now scattered around the world!

Now, only YOU can help Santa to Fix The Christmas:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/a42c2886c354d3eee5b855a251ce337775efe8ab.png

Santa's sleigh crashed somewhere over Canada. Gifts and Decorations are now scattered around the world.

Let's save this Christmas by filling Santa's Bag with lost gifts, decorating the Christmas tree and catching Antlered Salmons to harness them in Santa’s sleigh.

Christmas magic will summon Crystal Fish, that can be caught only during the holiday. So stock up on snow, toss snowballs at your friends and have lots of fun and adventures on White Moose Lake!

Travel to White Moose lake and find Santa's sleigh.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/e2c365a8d9ac589259d8c668bf38f48cd10cdf18.png

Catch Antlered Salmons to harness them in Santa’s sleigh instead of his runaway reindeer. Keep in mind, that Antlered Salmon bite best when someone launches fireworks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/50dac769451b01e4f5b0ebcef0175dc3fd9daea5.png

Fill Santa's Bag as you explore the waterways by boat in search of lost gifts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/6b06351a807d76cebd6d0cdea6718d8c93644743.png

Bring Christmas mood to the White Moose and help Santa decorate the Christmas Tree with collected ornaments.

*Catch fish to find Christmas tree ornaments that got stuck on their fins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/1c5c2896fef8e09a546f73b6c61f5e40c98dc26e.png
Snowfighter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/882b3637b747f49e9cbabea2f02e04e4a8096b85.png
Don't miss the opportunity to chill out and play some snowfight. Get a pack of nice and clean snow. Just perfect source of Snowballs and get crazy with new ingame activity. Hit certain number of players with Snowballs

Christmas gifts!
Rodstand the Snowman
This exclusive Christmas rod stand in the form of a jolly snowman will be your trusty companion when fishing this holiday season! Provides effective support for up to 2 rods.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/c6f8aecf6d43226aa4bdfde6eea1d2d7b0cd6ea7.png

CrystaLite™ Bomber Hat 
There’s no better headpiece for angling in extreme cold and blizzards than this cool bomber hat!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/b69819d93a9b3a2330d6d45704cd3d5f211b350e.png

Christmas Tackle Thermobox
This delightful Santa-themed lure box is meant exclusively for the adventurous anglers who succeed in completing all Christmas fishing missions! Sturdy and roomy, the Santa Chummer is made of thermo-regulating material to withstand the coldest of temperatures and features additional slots for chum components!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/ab515129386bff12037b17904b4a419a586afab5.png

Catch the mythical Crystal Burbot!
Complete all missions and get your chance to find out what is waiting for you in the water.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/bc10c73c3d925d0465ca7ec62eb2582aed36ee94.png

Make sure to join our fairytale fishing adventure with fairytale fish like fantastic Antlered Salmon and Furry Trout, fireworks and festive excitement!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/5e2b96fb4c76a678ab23d50c4011b0d4097d50e9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/9f0f0df3e00cbc0828fa1a6db345a4d9cda6f3c8.png
Have fun catching these magical Christmas event fish while the fireworks are blasting and complete the Myth Buster and Deer Hunter challenges to get unique holiday rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/a8b8a895e811aab604ec0f444e1b4a405d60d22d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/ed50ba1669dfb6295e90694affdf057f897d41c1.png

You can also try to complete the new Fishy Racing challenge and get a unique Elven Kayak as a prize!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/1f54a52124f7ad3410814d9b49393d1d696cc531.png

Merry Christmas and a fantastic New Year!

notes.title: Challenge The Char Charger Open!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9666527/2c1c9468cd4a0a0431f23e15b23906b8c903cb53.png
Spring’s drawing to a close with summer about to take it’s the rightful spot. What better way to close the season than with one of the most exciting Tournaments you’re gonna see this year! The Char Charger's Open is all about catching the many fish pertaining to the Char genus, which means all your favorite kinds of Trout! Held on the North America’s top Trout fishing destinations - from the cold and beautiful banks of Alaska’s Kaniq Creek, to the breathtaking Saint-Croix Lake in Michigan and the snowy Canadian White Moose Lake, this exciting event will have you competing with fellow anglers in 2 preliminary Qualifiers as well as the Semifinal and the Final Round that’ll settle the dispute of who’s the Char Champion once and for all!

Char Charger’s Open will be held May 20th through May 24th, with the Registration starting on May 19th, 24 hours prior to the First Qualifier.

The Tournament timetable is as follows:
 19th of May - Registration for the Tournament begins.
 20th of May - Qualifier 1 on Alaska’s Kaniq Creek.
 21st of May - Qualifier 2 on Michigan’s Lake Saint-Croix.
 23rd of May - Semifinal Round on the snowy White Moose Lake way out in Canada.
 24th of May - the Grand Finale on White Moose Lake.

notes.title: The Fisherman - Fishing Planet | General Stability Updates & Next Steps
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/d5e3649770e636cb91ef965e8bc9178fe64b1a97.png

Hello Fellow Fishermen, 

First of all, we’d like to apologise for the lack of communication around The Fisherman – Fishing Planet. We’re aware of all the feedback you’ve given since launch, and want to address these in the best way possible. 

With that in mind, we’ve got a couple of announcements, first up is that we’re releasing an update today that will address some of the general stability issues within The Fisherman – Fishing Planet, especially in regards to online performance. 

 Connection Stability Improvements Improved connection to the online servers, resulting in less cases of random disconnection
 Reductions in the instances of freezing or lag This refers to instances where the game was played for longer periods of time, resulting in micro-stutters or slowdowns in the general gameplay
 Other minor bug fixes

Moving forward we’re looking to tackle some of the bugs you’ve been highlighting in the forum and improve the overall performance of The Fisherman.

Additionally, we’ll be working with the developers to bring new content created for Fishing Planet to The Fisherman as paid additions to the game. We’ll be starting with the Mississippi Blue Crab Island, which will be released later this Spring. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/95a4994ecf280f71d765f8fe7bdfade92cb0faea.png

Mississippi Blue Crab Island includes: Level Cap Increase (55)
 New Waterway – Mississippi Blue Crab Island
 New Fish Species Bonefish
 Speckled Peacock Bass
 Southern Flounder
 Permit
 New Trophy + Unique Fish
 New Equipment
 New Boats
 New Collection Missions

We’ll go into more detail about the Mississippi Blue Crab Island closer to launch. However, if your purchase the DLC, you’ll have instant access to everything mentioned above and more.

notes.title: The Fisherman - Fishing Planet FAQ
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

In response to some common community questions, we've wrote an FAQ to try and address common players issues and questions regarding The Fisherman - Fishing Planet. 

What is The Fisherman - Fishing Planet? 
The Fisherman - Fishing Planet is an alternate version of Fishing Planet, featuring all of the DLC available in the current game, with a reworked progression system, changes to the license system, a reworked leveling experience, and more changes. It's designed to offer an alternative to the current edition of Fishing Planet for new players who perhaps don't enjoy the F2P model or for fans looking to own all of the content available in the game.

Since these are separate versions of the game, the character profiles and multiplayer servers are kept separate. If you already own everything in the regular version of Fishing Planet, then we'd recommend you keep enjoying that experience. 

What is different in The Fisherman compared to Fishing Planet? 
Previously we mentioned some of the differences between The Fisherman and the free to play version of Fishing Planet. While not exhaustive, here is a detailed list: 
 It’s pay to own (there are no microtransactions in the Fisherman)
 All of the items from the currently released DLC, which can be bought with baitcoins from the in-game shop in The Fisherman. 
 Tournament themed DLC can be purchased by baitcoins in the Packs menu.
 Items from Events, Sport and other DLC are available in the in-game store. 
 Travel + day fees + gear repair fees are 50% cheaper
 Licenses are unlimited and bought with in-game credits
 Unique fish give baitcoins
 It runs on separate servers, characters and multiplayer are completely different from those in Fishing Planet. 
 There is new exclusive content to The Fisherman (4 new fish, a new fishing technique and a new river)
 Reworked progression system (experience gains, credit gains, baitcoin system etc.) 

Where is the DLC from Fishing Planet in The Fisherman? 
All of the content available in Fishing Planet is available in The Fisherman, you can unlock these by spending baitcoins in the in-game shop. Baitcoins can be earned by fishing or completing missions in The Fisherman - Fishing Planet.

Will the original Fishing Planet still be supported? 
The original Fishing Planet will still receive regular content and updates. 

Are there microtransactions for The Fisherman: Fishing Planet?
There are no microtransactions in The Fisherman - Fishing Planet. Everything in the shops is bought using the two kinds of in-game currency. These currencies cannot and will not be able to be bought with real-world currency. 

Crossplay?
There is no crossplay available for The Fisherman - Fishing Planet. 

Which languages are supported in The Fisherman - Fishing Planet?
The game's text is available in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

Does the game require an always-on internet connection?
Yes, you need a permanent online connection to play The Fisherman - Fishing Planet.

Can I join friends playing Fishing Planet while playing The Fisherman - Fishing Planet?
The Fisherman - Fishing Planet servers are not the same as the Fishing Planet servers. You can't join friends playing the original version of Fishing Planet.

Can I transfer my progress from Fishing Planet to The Fisherman?
The progress system in The Fisherman - Fishing Planet has been overhauled, and the servers are kept separate from one another. For that reason, you can't transfer your Fishing Planet account to The Fisherman - Fishing Planet.
